title: Aerospace company's government customers on the program (CIA, Air Force)

tellings.quote: do know from the um Aerospace company that I interacted with quite frequently during the assap they did go to the government customer it wasn't always a CIA it was Air Force at times

plain: Eric Davis, who worked on AAWSAP, a Pentagon-funded study of UFOs in the late 2000s, says an aerospace company he dealt with often during that time told him it went to its government customer about the programme. He says that customer was not always the CIA, the US spy agency, but at times the Air Force, which, if true, would mean several agencies were involved.
